parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the front panel of the toaster, typically used to control functions such as cancel or reheat.
parts.Functional_description: The button allows the user to activate or stop the toasting process, providing control over the operation.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Slider
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lever or slider on the side of the toaster used to lower and raise the bread carriage.
parts.Functional_description: The slider engages the internal mechanism to start the toasting cycle and hold the bread in place until the cycle completes.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically up and down, locking in place during operation and releasing automatically when toasting is done.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the toaster made of stainless steel, housing the heating elements and internal mechanisms.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support, heat insulation, and protection for the internal components of the toaster.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed frame for all other moving parts.
